title: The polynomial source norm of a target function is invariant
statement:
Let $U=\operatorname{Spec}A$ and $R=\operatorname{Spec}B$ be affine schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Let $s,t:R\to U$, $e:U\to R$, $i:R\to R$, and $c:R\times_{s,U,t}R\to R$ [def-pc-fibre-product] define a groupoid: functorially in every test scheme $H$, they make $U(H)$ the objects and $R(H)$ the arrows, with source $s$, target $t$, identity $e$, inverse $i$, and composition $c$. Assume $s,t$ are finite locally free [def-pc-finite-locally-free]. Write $\sigma=s^\sharp,\tau=t^\sharp:A\to B$ and $C=\{a\in A:\sigma(a)=\tau(a)\}$. For an indeterminate $T$, write $\sigma[T],\tau[T]:A[T]\to B[T]$ for the coefficientwise extensions fixing $T$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring]. For every $F\in A[T]$, the determinant norm satisfies
$$
Q_F(T):=N_{\sigma[T]}\bigl(\tau[T](F)\bigr)\in C[T]\subset A[T].
$$
Equivalently, $\sigma[T](Q_F)=\tau[T](Q_F)$ in $B[T]$. The norm here is the finite locally free norm section of [lem-pd-finite-locally-free-norm-charts]: locally on $\operatorname{Spec}(A[T])$ where $B[T]$ is free as an $A[T]$-module via $\sigma[T]$, it is the determinant [def-weil-endomorphism-determinant] of multiplication by the indicated element; these local determinants are glued. No constant rank or reducedness is assumed.

source.place: Tag 03BH (groupoids-lemma-determinant-trick), applied to the groupoid after adjoining a common polynomial coordinate, as in the second paragraph of lemma-integral-over-invariants; determinant norm and base change are Tag 02DV (exercises-exercise-trace-det-rings)(1),(3).

proof.text: Adjoin one common polynomial coordinate to both affine schemes, replacing A and B by A[T] and B[T] and the structure maps by their coefficientwise extensions. The groupoid identities remain true coefficientwise, so this is the product of the given groupoid with the affine line. Finite locally free morphisms remain finite locally free after this base change, with the rank allowed to vary on the same open charts.

source.place: Tag 03BH, after adjoining a common polynomial coordinate; Tag 02DV (exercises-exercise-trace-det-rings)(3) for finite locally free base change

proof.text: Apply the source-norm invariance lemma to this polynomial-coordinate groupoid and to the element F of A[T]. Its statement gives N_{\sigma[T]}(\tau[T](F)) in the equalizer of \sigma[T] and \tau[T], hence the source and target images of this norm agree in B[T]. The norm is the local determinant norm, so it is the Q_F specified in the statement.

source.place: Tag 03BH (groupoids-lemma-determinant-trick), applied to the polynomial-coordinate groupoid

proof.text: A polynomial lies in the equalizer of the coefficientwise maps \sigma[T] and \tau[T] exactly when each coefficient lies in C=\{a\in A:\sigma(a)=\tau(a)\}. Therefore Q_F(T) belongs to C[T], and this coefficientwise assertion is equivalent to \sigma[T](Q_F)=\tau[T](Q_F).
